newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Feb output fall due to brisk Jan figure-MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan Feb output fall due to brisk Jan figure-MITI.

text.p: A month-on-month drop in Japan's industrial production in February was mainly due to a reaction to brisk production in January, a senior official of the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Friday.
MITI announced that output in February fell 3.4 percent from January.
The official told reporters that a fire at a plant making brake parts for Toyota Motor Corp was also partly responsible for the fall in February.
Production at Toyota was affected for four days in February due to the fire.
"A strong production trend is likely to continue at least until the end of April," the official said.
Asked if a planned increase in Japan's consumption tax on April 1 would affect production in April and in ensuing months, the official said he could not say there would be no impact.
He said there seemed likely to be some impact from the consumption tax increase on auto production in April.
He predicted that production of telecoms equipment, computers and cars would contribute to the expected rise in April production.
